decisions.evidence: Taken together, the molecule is large, polar, and heavily ionization- and hydrogen-bonding-prone, with an extremely low neutral fraction and a very high TPSA, so the overall profile is more consistent with option (A), not permeable to cell membranes in a PAMPA assay.
The overall comparison therefore supports option (A): is not permeable to cell membranes in a PAMPA assay.
